properties.entry: Close colony. Return back to main world view.

A colony with this name already exists. Choose another name.

Select a colonist with movement remaining on unoccupied land outside mountains, away from existing colonies.
The available goods changed. Review the updated choice and confirm again or cancel.
This colonist is no longer available at your colony on your turn. Nothing was changed. Cancel and select the colonist again.

No eligible field is available for this crop.
